title: Buddhistic Teachings
definition: The philosophical teachings of Siddhartha Gautama, the Buddha, primarily focusing on the Four Noble Truths and the Eightfold Path.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Life is suffering, caused by craving. To end suffering, follow the Eightfold Path.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: The Buddha taught about the cycle of suffering (dukkha), the cause of suffering (samudaya), the end of suffering (nirodha), and the path to end suffering (magga).
difficulty_levels.expert: The Buddha's teachings are a critical source in Mahayana Buddhism, which emphasizes the interdependence of all things and the role of compassion and wisdom in achieving enlightenment.

extra_fields.insight: Suffering is real, it has a cause, it can end, and there is a path.
